integrity: The packaged proof derives a symmetry-reduced tilted generator and its dominant eigenvalue; finite tests are cross-checks, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact claim is for 3 spins and real counting fields; no all-ring or finite-time entropy law is asserted. Independent audit and priority verification remain unperformed.
title: Exact entropy-production fluctuations in a three-spin nonreciprocal Ising ring
